items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: 'Junkman's Rag' -- we played that for the President of France, President Pointcaire.

ctx.x: : He wrote a couple of very profitable songs, too, didn't he?
Yeah, when I was in the army. 'Junkman's Rag' -- we played that for the President of France, President Pointcaire.
: And that was Lucky Roberts's tune.
